title: Canonical Descriptor Wrapper
description: Wraps a harvested-or-authored descriptor with provenance + classification metadata so the descriptor-emission prompt can select a triple-matching reference at compile time. The inner `descriptor` field is a full v0.3 descriptor that MUST validate against `descriptor.schema.v0.3.json` + the semantic rules — enforced by the canonical_descriptors coherence test. Mirrors the audit-registry's `examples` face cornerstone (positive examples pass all validators), scaled from per-rule fragments to per-archetype whole descriptors.

format_version.description: Canonical-descriptor wrapper version. Bump when the wrapper shape changes incompatibly.

classification.description: The classification triple this canonical exemplifies. The selector matches incoming Step-0 classifications against this triple. Three axes (archetype, shape, modality) chosen as the most behavior-relevant; tool_involvement and source_runtime tracked separately if useful.

tool_involvement_variant.description: Optional fourth axis — recorded for selector secondary-scoring but not required for match.

source_runtime.description: Optional fifth axis — recorded for selector tertiary-scoring.

source.description: Where this canonical came from — either a skill name harvested from a clean compile, or `hand-authored` when the canonical was written from scratch to fill a coverage gap.

harvested_at.description: ISO date when the canonical was harvested or authored. Provenance only; not used by the selector.

notes.description: Free-text notes about why this canonical is useful, what patterns it demonstrates, and any known limitations the LLM should NOT pattern-match on. Audience: a maintainer triaging a canonical that has started failing the coherence check.

descriptor.description: The actual descriptor — a full v0.3 descriptor that MUST validate cleanly against the current schema + semantic rules (enforced by coherence test). When schemas tighten, broken canonicals fail loudly and a maintainer updates them.
